segments.name: Baidu General Business
segments.description: Provides online marketing services and other offerings including cloud services to advertisers and business customers in Chinese mainland.
segments.evidence: Baidu General Business mainly provides online marketing services and others including cloud services.

segments.name: iQIYI
segments.description: Produces, aggregates and distributes professionally produced and other video content, and sells video membership services to subscribing members.
segments.evidence: iQIYI produces, aggregates and distributes a wide variety of professionally produced content, as well as a broad spectrum of other video content, in a variety of formats.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for sponsored links and other online marketing, while customers pay for cloud services and iQIYI video memberships.
revenueModel.evidence: Our P4P platform enables customers to bid for priority placement of paid sponsored links and reach users who search for information related to their products or services.
